scope: first controlled verified self-distillation cycle; not a claim of general, long-horizon or frontier coding ability
implementation_gate: Collection implementation is frozen separately. Candidate training and four-arm evaluation implementations must be published, CI-checked and hash-frozen before their respective first execution. No scientific rule change after any new development model score.

training_data_gate.selection: all eligible whole episodes; all audited executed valid actions; no target truncation, no partial-episode filtering, no hidden-check or reference-restoration supervision

candidate.initialization: verified pinned base, never a previous adapter
candidate.lora_target_profile: same language-model module expression as capacity-profile.json
candidate.loss: assistant target tokens only; mean supervised-token loss per record, averaged over actual record count in each accumulation window
candidate.order: sort action records by SHA256 of UTF8(025-student-v1 plus literal NUL plus record id); one pass, all eligible records exactly once
candidate.checkpoint_selection: only end of the complete epoch; no development-driven selection or retry
required_integrity: all frozen parameters have no gradients
all loss and gradient norms finite
saved adapter reload matches a training-only greedy probe

development.decoding: greedy; same pinned base tokenizer, chat template, backend and 024 feedback normalization
development.runtime_intervention: explicit_submission_guard_v1 only; identical visible task prompt and tools otherwise
development.order: Within each repetition, tasks sorted by SHA256(UTF8(025-dev-v1 plus literal NUL plus repetition index 0..2 plus literal NUL plus task id)). For task index i, arm order is the four listed arms cyclically rotated left by (i + repetition index) modulo 4. Each four-arm task block completes before the next task.
development.primary_score: fraction of tasks with changed source passing fresh independent grading within actor caps; explicit-submit rate reported separately
development.ordinary_failure_policy: no edit, wrong patch, format, tool failure and actor budget exhaustion count as failures, not exclusions
development.infrastructure_failure_policy: retain traces and all costs; no silent rerun, no positive complete-cycle claim with missing pairs or unaccounted generation

analysis.primary_parameter_effect: student_current minus base_current, mean over the 60 per-task three-repeat success fractions
analysis.uncertainty: paired two-level bootstrap: resample six repository families with replacement, then ten tasks within each selected family; retain all three repeats per selected task; 10000 draws with seed 25025; 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles
analysis.limitations: Only six repository clusters and short authored faults: confidence intervals are limited evidence and do not establish general coding or long-task ability. Three repeats are not 180 independent tasks. Extra system compute is not reported as parameter gain.
